clips.title: The story
paras: Horde caravans and warriors travel the Gold Road through the Barrens. It runs from Mor'shan Rampart on the border of Ashenvale, past the Crossroads, toward the south.

The Gold Road is a long dirt highway through the center of the Barrens. Near its northern end, Mor'shan Rampart and Mor'shan Base Camp guard against night elf incursions from Ashenvale. Farther south, an eastern roadway connects directly to Durotar before the Gold Road reaches the Crossroads. Beyond the settlement, it passes the waters of local oases and the foothills near the Wailing Caverns. The northern span ends at a dried-up riverbed, where travelers enter the more dangerous southern Barrens.

The Gold Road carries Horde trade and military movements between Kalimdor's central territories, but danger follows its length. Quilboar tribes, centaur warbands, plainstriders, and lions threaten supply caravans and lone messengers. The Horde spends considerable resources placing scouts and warriors along the road. Even so, travelers leave the safety of major outposts armed and alert.
